_description: Tunable thresholds for the detection pipeline. All numbers referenced by detect.py.

baseline._description: Rolling 14-day average baseline. Reset after 10 stable days post-config-change.

f1_kb_gap._description: KB gap: kb_hit=false rate exceeds 50% sustained, kb_top_score below 0.40, resolution drops >20%.

f2_silent_tool_failure._description: Silent tool fail: outcome=ok AND result_field_count=0 rate exceeds 8% (baseline is 0%). Declared error_rate stays flat.

f3_prompt_regression._description: Prompt regression: median turns up >30% above baseline, resolution stays flat, cost rises.

d1_mix_shift._description: Mix shift dismissal: intent share shifts >4% sustained 5+ days, peak >6%. Per-intent rates stay within 8%.

d2_load_spike._description: Load spike dismissal: volume >30% above baseline, latency >50% up, quality flat, self-corrects.

d3_judge_change._description: Judge change dismissal: quality drops across ALL tenants simultaneously near a judge config change.

deduplication._description: Problems within 3 days on same tenant+primary_metric+cohort_key are merged.

general._description: Flag if 25% drift from baseline. Look back 0-5 days for config changes. Min 20 sessions in anomaly window.
